description:
Senior Platform Engineer 
 Location : Remote (U.S.)
 Clearance : U.S. Citizenship required; must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust (active Public Trust a plus)
 Employment Type : Full-time

  

 Make an Impact on Federal Health :

 
 Join Rackner to build and operate the secure, cloud-native platform that powers data, analytics, and AI/ML for a federal health mission.

 You won't just run infrastructure — you'll own the internal developer platform that data scientists, data engineers, and application teams build on every day.

 Shape where it goes next: production-grade MLOps, self-service onboarding, and a paved road from commit to GovCloud.

 
 Who You Are :

 
 7+ years in Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, Site Reliability, or Cloud Engineering, with senior-level ownership of a production platform

 Built an internal developer platform / PaaS from the ground up for federal clients — and taken it to production (through ATO) in a federal program, not just contributed to one

 Extensive hands-on experience across both the open-source cloud-native/data ecosystem (Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Karpenter/KEDA, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Trino, Dagster, dbt) and the AWS services that back them (EKS, S3, Glue, IAM/IRSA, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, Athena)

 Deep expertise with Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux), and Terraform infrastructure-as-code

 Designs for self-service: golden paths, multi-tenancy, and onboarding that lets teams ship safely without a platform engineer in the loop

 Strong CI/CD background (GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and progressive delivery)

 Fluent automation and scripting (Python, Bash, Go)

 Working knowledge of federal compliance (NIST 800-53, FISMA, ATO processes); comfortable in GovCloud/regulated environments

 Treats documentation and knowledge transfer as part of "done" — clear docs and runbooks come naturally

 A people person and problem-solver who's comfortable being client-facing, wearing many hats, mentoring teammates, and growing into technical leadership

 
 What You'll Do :

 
 Own the IaC + GitOps foundation — evolve Terraform and ArgoCD (ApplicationSets) so the platform is declarative, self-healing, and recoverable from scratch

 Build and operate a multi-tenant, self-service platform — golden-path app onboarding, tenant/environment management, an app & tooling catalog, and internal developer tooling/CLI

 Run Kubernetes on AWS GovCloud — Karpenter and KEDA autoscaling, ingress and Gateway API, cert-manager, and ALB integration across dev/pre-prod/production

 Architect and deploy AIOps/MLOps for data science and data engineering teams — GPU compute and scheduling, model training and serving, managed notebooks (e.g., SageMaker), GenAI/Bedrock workloads, and production-grade ML pipelines

 Enable the data lakehouse — Trino/Iceberg on Glue + S3, Dagster orchestration, dbt, and search — so teams have reliable, performant data access

 Deliver observability and SLOs — Prometheus, Grafana (including custom-built dashboards), and actionable alerting

 Automate security and compliance — secrets management, network policy, IRSA least-privilege, policy-as-code, vulnerability remediation, and ATO artifact generation

 Drive documentation and knowledge transfer — author and maintain platform docs, production-readiness standards, and runbooks

 Partner directly with government stakeholders and platform tenants — translate mission needs into platform capabilities, with room to grow into a technical leadership role

 
 Preferred / Bonus :

 
 Hands-on MLOps/AIOps production experience for DS/DE teams — SageMaker, Bedrock, Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, KServe/Triton/Seldon, or GPU workload scheduling

 Experience with federal health or other regulated federal data programs

 Data platform / lakehouse experience — Trino/Presto, Iceberg, Spark, Dagster/Airflow, dbt

 AWS GovCloud, IL4/IL5, FedRAMP, or air-gapped environment experience

 Policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno), container security, SBOMs, and vulnerability scanning

 Kubecost/cloud cost management

 Experience establishing a documentation practice and production-readiness standards

 
 Who We Are :

 
 Rackner is a cloud-native software consultancy delivering solutions for startups, enterprises, and the public sector

 We enable digital transformation through DevSecOps, platform engineering, AI/ML, and cloud-first innovation

 Join a team that thrives on solving high-impact problems and delivering secure, scalable systems for federal missions

 
 Why You'll Love Working Here :

 
 Weekly Pay & Fully Remote

 Professional Growth – Paid certifications and training for relevant technologies

 Comprehensive Benefits – 401k (100% match up to 6%), PTO, medical/dental/vision, life & disability insurance

 Work-Life Perks – Gym/fitness membership, home office setup, swag, snacks, and social events
